subject: Unforeseen field condition: conflicting utility line beneath the slab area at Placement

messages.text: We found the conflicting utility line beneath the slab area at Placement Zone 2; see Project Specifications Division 00 for the assumed condition. Our proposal is to shift the layout locally and hold everything else per plan -- let us know if that works or if you need to review first. We would like this resolved ahead of the next work sequence. This condition will require a change order. No broader schedule impact is expected. Please respond this week so we can keep the crew moving.
We'll need photos and measurements of the conflicting utility line beneath the slab area at Placement Zone 2 before we can evaluate the workaround. This condition will require a change order.

Attached photos show that the condition at Placement Zone 2 is more extensive than first reported; our workaround proposal still holds otherwise. Please respond this week so we can keep the crew moving.
